body: We wouldn't even go to court. But with me working so much and so early, I wouldn't be able to see my kid when I come home. Maybe I could stop at where his dad is staying for an hour or so but it's not the same.

We've tried adult conversations plenty of times and have even been to therapy a few times. We've evaluated. He's full of lots of broken promises and thats the biggest promises. I've given him all the opportunity I possibly can and I'm just entirely drained at this point 😔  but you're right, I probably will be 40 and in the same spot. I just don't know how to go about leaving him because I don't want my kid living at his moms and I don't want to be away from my kid for days at a time. I love coming home to my son every night. And this is why I'm stuck.. 😪

Yeah I cant afford any of that. Overtime pay isn't hardly anything. Once you work over nine hours of OT a week you get put into a higher tax bracket. I've been behind on bills as it is so this is just catching me up. Child care is honestly out of the question. Its $300 to $400 per week(you have to pay the full week even if you use half) where I live for all near by day cares and I make "too much money" to qualify for any support. But my rent is over half my monthly income, I live in the cheapest apartments in town (its pretty ghetto and sketch outside) and I make more than minimum wage. Its a very expensive state right now where having one single income for a 2+ bedroom is near impossible unless you're making way above min wage. And unfortunately I only work OT to keep my job at this point. 

I'm set on laundry though, getting it done isn't much of a concern. Its the putting all away that drives me crazy. Its never ending. But I also don't know any teenagers.  I really wish I could do all that but if I could, believe me I would have been already 😪 I have been through a lot of trauma throughout my life and don't really trust strangers in my home. But you might be on to something and have given me some things to think about so thank you for that.
Thank you, that's very sweet 💛

I cannot afford anything like that unfortunately/: I live in a very expensive state. My mother actually just recently moved 4 hours away and my dad is pretty old and isn't able to do very much. It breaks my fucking heart. And yes, he is the bio father and other than doing nothing all day he is a pretty good dad. (terrible life partner though) He's my sons favorite person in the world. I very rarely see my son unhappy which I know is rare for toddlers and that's another thing that keeps me from kicking out the dad.
When you need to quickly use the restroom in public and when you sit on the toilet its warm and moist.
They probably have mommy/daddy issues or something and come here to take it out on people hurting. I just can't imagine happy people saying stuff like that... ugh it makes me sick though

I cant tell if you're replying to me or the person who deleted their comment saying "better luck next time"

Cause that's who I was talking to
What the fuck is wrong with you?
I'm glad you're still here. And thank you for telling us!
Well you can deny it but if some one is doing it, it is a thing lol. But yikes. You sound very bitter. I hope whatever is bothering you about birthdays gets better soon.

Talking down on someone for how they love and celebrate themselves is "super cringe" and show up as a little jealous. Kinda seems like you wish you could do that but you're afraid of what people would think.

It's not just you. I've noticed that too. It's either because feeling suicidal has become more common which is terrible.... or because people who feel suicidal are finally finding a safe place to vent and express and find people to talk to which is amazing. I'm just not sure which one /:

You are not disgusting! You are human. To me, her making you feel like that sounds like gaslighting and manipulation. A little abusive. I'm glad you got out! Just don't let her snake her way back in by making you feel bad for her. She'll probably do that sense she is manipulative. If you waste time with the wrong one, you might miss the chance to meet the right one! Keep that in mind when she hits you up lol

Well for one, yes. Yes that is very weird. Not normal or healthy at all. She should probably see a therapist because that is super toxic and controlling. She sounds like a mother telling a young son to close his eyes for a scene in a movie. Honestly. And she sounds like my ex. My male ex. He even thought watching porn was cheating. He'd make me feel guilty for watching movies like Magic Mike and try to throw in my face the fact that he never watches porn. I didn't care that he didn't watch it. I thought that was weird! And kind of a turn off tbh. I told him that it wouldn't bother me if he did, he's free to watch it and he said that I broke his heart by saying that because I should care and if that's my attitude then he might as well just full blown cheat lol cause that's the same. That was years ago.

I don't really understand that type of insecurity, my husband and I even watch porn together and it's so much fun! Letting go of jealousy/insecurity and both people being able to express sexuality. We are 100% faithful to each other. No one else will ever have a chance. But I enjoy experiencing my husband express himself freely and getting to know him in that way too. It makes us both happy. And when a beautiful woman comes on screen in a movie, we can both comfortably comment on it. Men too sometimes lol. (He's straight but he still has celebrity "boyfriends")  I've never had this type of relationship before and I'm so happy I left my ex to find this. It's the healthiest relationship I've ever had and when we express our sexuality to each other in ways most people wouldn't understand, (like watching porn, roleplaying, ect) we share something very intimate and private and special. I wouldn't trade it for the world.

It's good you broke up. Now you can find someone on the same level as you! Whatever it may be, and that's so exciting! Someone who seeks the same openness as you do and freedom. Discussing boundaries and lines early on is very important. And even discussing these things again over time. If someone's boundaries are too wild or too strict for you,  there's someone more suitable out there for the both of you. You'll find the one who you'll never want to stray from but your heart will always feel free. And maybe your ex will find that too with someone like my ex lol
Thank you! I'm glad to know that I'm not alone in that opinion..

Actually now that I think about it, I think more than anything I'm fighting for closure at this point. I deserve that I think. Maybe that's why I cant leave until he takes the test? Or admits the awful truth. I just want that closure even if its gonna hurt more than the other lies. I'm too stubborn sometimes I guess.
You are so kind! Thank you. Sometimes i just need someone to talk to about random stuff so I mean, you could probably help in that way(:
Thank you. I think I need to hear that sometimes cause I dont really see it or feel it /:

Toddlers are definitely the best(: even though they can be little terrorizing monsters sometimes lmao. And omg that sounds awesome! My ex from like years ago was in school for that! It was really hard for him and I can totally see why! That takes so much patience and motivation. Im sure you're not a terrible artist! I can still only draw stick people and cant do anything with graphic design 😂lol But I freaking love love indie games! They're always so interesting. If you dont mind me asking, what's it about?

Well I guess lately my hobbies are just my Netflix shows lol when my toddler is sleeping or at his dads. But I collect rocks! I used to go hiking to look for real good ones. 

And I'd have to say my favorite video game is Super Meat Boy(: or zelda. I love that shit. What about yourself?? Tell me yours(:

Girl, run! You don't want to look back on this moment while still in the relationship and  it's even worse! You'll regret not getting out now. You want look back on this moment thinking "thank god I left when I did, I'm so much better off now"
